profile.headline: Software Engineer at Stripe
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer building optimized payment experiences at Stripe!

I have a passion for developing high performance systems, software, and teams. I believe there's far greater value in growing 10x teams than finding 10x individuals.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Ad marketplace, low-latency real-time auction, ranking, selection, pricing, experimentation, offline simulation

positions.title: Software Development Engineer I
positions.description: Ad APIs, event consumers, data services, data modeling, persistence

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Built a horizontally scalable pipeline for product advertisement data reporting and storage
• Migrated traditional database systems to NoSQL technologies using distributed platform solutions
• Wrote a technical specification for re-architecting an aggregation publishing service to scale with map reduce

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Resolved active sustaining calls and emptied the entire backlog of engineering support calls older than 6 months through developing Windows client/server and web-based security-as-a-service applications
• Worked with a small agile team of 5 coders to expand functionality and coverage of the Proofpoint email archiving service
• Enhanced client side functionality between Microsoft Outlook, Exchange, and Proofpoint email archiving service using C++ and MFCMAPI
• Improved reliability and stability of back-end email message parsing done using Swing and Java
• Utilized VMware ESX and vSphere to test and develop front to back end execution of Proofpoint’s complex SaaS environment

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Designed, implemented, and maintained an infrastructure framework to simulate re-engineered McAfee antivirus engine functionality using C++
• Realigned and modified McAfee Virus Scan components for compatibility with the new engine based upon design document specifications
• Created a set of unit test suites for testing functionality and performance of new feature implementation

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed Windows and web based installers for McAfee’s consumer product modules
• Designed, implemented, and documented an instrumentation data collection tool for gathering data from beta test release candidates written in C++
• Integrated the data collection tool with application and web installers to track how users interact with different installers using C#, XML, and JavaScript

positions.title: IT Desktop Support Intern
positions.description:
• Supported engineers with quality technical support for a wide range of technologies and devices
• Worked in a team of 7 to deliver efficient and effective service through leveraging of ticket and collaboration tools
• Solved complex software and hardware problems through research, education, and communication

positions.title: Information Communication Technology Intern
positions.description:
• Worked with 2 team members to supply technical support and training to 200+ employees located in Canada, US, and UK.
• Maintained Courtyard Group’s managed server infrastructure through installation and maintenance of physical systems
• Implemented and deployed numerous enterprise services such as antivirus, virtualization, Active Directory, Microsoft Exchange, and VoIP
